一本书可以同时放进几个合集。长按合集可以重命名或删除。: A book can be in several collections. Long-press a collection to rename or delete it.
书、进度、笔记和生词都存在这台设备上。打开同步时，它们只在你的设备和你自己选的网: Your books, progress, notes and words stay on this device. With sync on, they travel only between your devices and the storage you choose (WebDAV or Google Drive); Yuyue never sees them.
书伴、云端声音和笔记导出只在你填了自己的 Key 时联网，提问、要读的句子或笔记: The companion, cloud voices and note export go online only when you add your own key: questions, sentences to read or notes go straight to the provider you chose. Keys stay on this device, encrypted.
完整的许可文本随源代码一起发布。: The full licence texts are published with the source code.
语阅没有服务器，也不收集任何数据：没有账号、没有统计、没有广告。: Yuyue has no servers and collects no data: no accounts, no analytics, no ads.
语阅用到了这些开源项目，感谢它们的作者：: Yuyue uses these open-source projects, with thanks to their authors:
Azure 门户里建一个“语音”资源，拷它的密钥和区域（比如 eastasia）: Create a Speech resource in the Azure portal and copy its key and region (such as eastus). There's a free tier.
elevenlabs.io › 个人资料 › API Keys。额度按字数算。: elevenlabs.io › Profile › API Keys. Usage is counted by characters.
platform.openai.com › API keys 里建一个。费用按字: Create one at platform.openai.com › API keys. Usage is billed to your account by length.
和 iPhone、Mac 用同一个 WebDAV 文件夹，进度和笔记就在这些设备: Use the same WebDAV folder as your iPhone or Mac, and progress and notes move between them.
密码存在这台设备上，加密保存。: The password stays on this device, encrypted.
系统声音在这台设备上合成，不联网。想要更自然的声音：在系统的“文字转语音”里下载: System voices are made on this device, offline. For more natural ones, download voice data in the system's Text-to-speech settings.
这台手机的系统读不出 PDF 里的字，Android 15 起才能朗读 PDF: This phone's system can't read the words in a PDF; reading PDFs aloud needs Android 15 or later
选一个同步方式就开始: Choose a way to sync to start
电脑和这台手机连同一个 Wi‑Fi: Connect the computer and this phone to the same Wi‑Fi
Key 只存在这台设备上，加密保存，不同步。提问和书里相关的几段原文直接发给你选: The key stays on this device, encrypted, and isn't synced. Your question and a few related passages go straight to the provider you chose; Yuyue never handles them.
放进这个文件夹的书，下次打开语阅时自动导入。可以是手机里的任何文件夹，比如“下载: Books put in this folder are imported the next time you open Yuyue. It can be any folder on the phone, such as Downloads or one a cloud drive app keeps in sync.
要让语阅读书时打开勿扰，先在系统里允许它管理勿扰。: To let Yuyue turn on Do Not Disturb while you read, allow it to manage Do Not Disturb in the system settings first.
读书时语阅打开勿扰，离开书页就关掉；你自己开的勿扰不会被动。: Yuyue turns on Do Not Disturb while you read and off when you leave the book; a Do Not Disturb you turned on yourself is left alone.
